comparison.objective: Install a rack bracket, versus refit a loaded drawer onto cabinet slides and verify it by closing and pull-testing.
comparison.physical_skill: Both may require bimanual support of an elongated/load-bearing component, constrained guided alignment, hook clearance, engagement, and release.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires unknown mounts engaged at an OpenU; PR requires drawer riding on both slides, closed hands-off, then reopened about 5 cm without losing its load.
comparison.reason: Potentially close guided support-hardware installation; the candidate lacks the geometry needed to prove a different insertion or latch ability.
